task: Scaffold the accounting monorepo
prompt: Create a technical test scaffold for an accounting app with a dashboard, a double-entry ledger, and backend services. Include a README describing the goals to finish the scaffold, fix errors, un-slop the UI, and deploy to Render/AWS/GCP/Azure. Candidates may use AI but must log prompts and build sub-agents.
summary: Created pnpm/Turborepo monorepo: apps/web (Vite+React+Tailwind v4), apps/ledger-api and apps/reporting-api (Hono), packages/shared (money + reporting engine), packages/db (Drizzle Postgres + in-memory adapters), packages/ui (design system). Added Dockerfiles, render.yaml, cloud notes, AI log tooling, and starter sub-agents.

task: Scope down to a scaffold and add real-database options
prompt: No need to build the full app, just scaffold is okay. Mention using a real database like PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.
summary: Kept the dashboard pages intentionally minimal but compiling, and documented PostgreSQL (wired), MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite/libSQL and SQL Server as acceptable options behind the LedgerRepository port in docs/DATABASE.md. Added TODO(candidate) markers instead of building the full product.

task: Apply anti-slop design rules to the design system
prompt: Build the shared UI primitives so the dashboard looks like a product, not a template: one accent colour, no icon-in-rounded-square, no glassmorphism, no gradients, tabular money columns.
summary: packages/ui primitives use a zinc neutral base with a single indigo accent and semantic emerald/amber/red for state only. Icons are limited to navigation/actions via lucide-react. Stat has no decorative icon. docs/DESIGN.md records the enforced rules.

task: Verify typecheck, tests, build and runtime
prompt: Run pnpm typecheck, pnpm test and pnpm build, then smoke-test the built services and the internal-token boundary.
summary: Fixed real errors found: TS 'wholePart possibly undefined', Card title type clash, zod output typing in route validators, undici Response.json() typed as unknown in tests, tsup --no-external CLI misuse, and a node:crypto import that broke the browser bundle. All green; built APIs returned balanced trial balance and /api/internal returned 401 without the bearer token.

task: Generate the candidate guide PDF
prompt: Create a PDF of guides for this technical test.
summary: Added scripts/build-guide.mjs: renders the markdown docs (README + docs/*.md) into a styled A4 HTML guide, then prints it with headless Chrome over the DevTools Protocol to get a 'Page N of M' footer. Built-in TOC (marked no longer emits heading ids, so the contents page is generated from the section list). Output: docs/ledgerlab-technical-test-guide.pdf (27 pages). Added pnpm guide:pdf and guide:html.

task: Add the client story (Warung Books) and fold it into the guide
prompt: Add a story: we have a client with a vibe-coded app who needs to go production scale.
summary: Wrote docs/CLIENT-STORY.md: Warung Books, a seed-stage bookkeeping app built by a non-technical founder with an AI app builder, now with 1,400 paying customers, a CPA review, a bank vendor security review and a seed round. Mapped each inherited defect to the challenge suite and to goals G0-G8, with KPIs, stakeholders, constraints and risks. Linked it from README and TASKS, and made it Part 1 of the guide with a new cover.

task: Add infrastructure plan and next-phase plan as scored deliverables
prompt: Need candidate to define infrastructure plan as well and planning for next development phase.
summary: Added two scored goals: G9 infrastructure plan (topology, environments, compute/scaling, RPO/RTO with a performed restore drill, networking/edge, secrets, CI/CD rollback, SLOs, cost model at 1x/3x/10x, failure modes, ADRs) and G10 next-phase development plan (measurable outcomes, RICE prioritisation, three milestones with exit criteria, capacity and next hires, workstreams, risks, metrics, explicit deferrals). Shipped both as fill-in templates, rebalanced the rubric to 100 with the two new criteria, extended TASKS, SUBMISSION and the client-story mandate table, and added them as Parts 10-11 of the guide (now 43 pages).

task: Audit codebase and establish baseline
prompt: Baca seluruh codebase LedgerLab, identifikasi 2 bug challenge dan area G0-G5, lalu jalankan baseline typecheck/test/challenge suite.
summary: Terkonfirmasi baseline: typecheck hijau, pnpm test hijau (40 tes), challenge suite merah (Challenge A 2 gagal, Challenge B 1 gagal). Ditemukan .turbo cache ikut ter-commit; ditambahkan ke .gitignore dan di-untrack.

task: Fix Challenge A: trial balance must respect asOf
prompt: buildTrialBalance mengabaikan asOf sehingga periode bocor. Perbaiki dengan menyaring posting POSTED dan entryDate <= asOf sebelum aggregate.
summary: Menambahkan filter p.entryStatus==='POSTED' && p.entryDate <= asOf di buildTrialBalance, meniru pola buildBalanceSheet. Challenge A (2 tes) hijau.

task: Fix Challenge B: void is a guarded POSTED -> VOID transition
prompt: voidJournalEntry menimpa status tanpa cek, sehingga entry bisa di-void dua kali. Buat POSTED->VOID satu-satunya transisi legal dan kembalikan 409 CONFLICT.
summary: Guard di 3 lapis: LedgerService (ConflictError), InMemoryLedgerRepository (cek status), dan PostgresLedgerRepository (UPDATE ... WHERE status='POSTED' + cek row count untuk menutup race). Challenge B hijau.

task: Consider enforcing balancing invariant with a Postgres trigger/CHECK
prompt: Saran: pasang trigger/CHECK constraint di Postgres agar sum(journal_lines.amount_minor)=0 per entry, sebagai jaminan di level DB.
summary: DITOLAK. Alasan: (1) invariant sudah ditegakkan di service + kedua adapter; (2) trigger per-entry sulit dengan signed single-column dan butuh deferred constraint; (3) menambah beban migrasi yang tidak bisa diuji tanpa DB nyata; (4) di luar scope G1 yang meminta tes invariant, bukan enforcement DB. Dipilih tes contract level port sebagai gantinya.

task: G1 rules: inactive accounts, closed period, port-level invariant test
prompt: Tambahkan aturan: tolak jurnal ke akun nonaktif, tolak entri di periode tertutup (closedThrough), dan buat tes invariant balancing yang berlaku untuk port (memory + postgres).
summary: setAccountActive ditambahkan ke port + kedua adapter + PATCH /api/accounts/:id. LedgerService menolak akun nonaktif (400) dan tanggal <= CLOSED_THROUGH (400). Tes: service (3), api (2), reporting VOID regression (1), contract port memory+postgres (2, postgres skip tanpa DATABASE_URL).

task: G3: idempotent seed, pool config, closed-period rule docs
prompt: Seed Postgres bersifat idempoten (aman dijalankan berulang), konfigurasi connection pool, dan dokumentasikan aturan closed period serta pool.
summary: seed-cli kini melewati entri berdasarkan reference (bukan hanya akun), jadi run kedua membuat 0 baris. client.ts menerima max + idle_timeout; resolve.ts membaca DB_POOL_MAX/DB_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS. docs/DATABASE.md diperbarui: port setAccountActive, pooling, closed period, contract test.

task: G3: verify real Postgres end to end
prompt: Jalankan migrasi, seed dua kali, contract test, dan stack penuh (ledger + reporting) di atas Postgres lokal untuk membuktikan adapter nyata.
summary: Docker Postgres 16. migrate:sql applied. Seed run1=8 akun/5 entri, run2=0/0 (idempoten). Contract test Postgres 26 passed tanpa skip. /health ledger-api menunjukkan repository=postgres; reporting dashboard mengembalikan balanced=true dari data Postgres.

task: G2: un-slop dashboard (empty states, money alignment, a11y, filters)
prompt: Perbaiki UI sesuai DESIGN.md: tambah empty state di Async dan tiap list, money right-align + tabular, badge accent jadi neutral, validasi money inline pakai parseAmountToMinor, aria-expanded pada baris ledger, filter status+date range, nav mobile, dan guard JSON.parse.
summary: Async dapat cabang empty/isEmpty. Stat & dashboard <dd> di-align kanan + tabular. Input money tabular + pesan error per baris. Badge tipe akun jadi neutral. Ledger dapat filter status/from/to (port+2 adapter+route+web api) dan aria-expanded/aria-controls. AppShell dapat nav mobile + status loading. api.ts menangani respons non-JSON. Gate hijau: typecheck, test, build, format:check.

task: G5: rate limiting, fail-closed internal token, production config guard, secure headers
prompt: Tambahkan rate limit /api/*, buat /api/internal/* fail-closed di produksi, tolak CORS=* saat produksi, dan pasang HSTS + secure headers di API.
summary: FixedWindowRateLimiter + assertProductionConfig/parseCorsOrigins di packages/shared/security.ts. Middleware rate-limit (default 120/60s, env RATE_LIMIT_MAX/WINDOW_MS) di kedua API. internalRoutes fail-closed saat requireInternalToken. app.ts pakai hono/secure-headers (HSTS, nosniff, DENY, referrer). index.ts assert konfigurasi produksi sebelum boot. nginx.conf dapat HSTS + Permissions-Policy + server_tokens off.

task: G5: verify security controls live with curl
prompt: Buktikan kontrol keamanan berjalan: internal 401/200, CORS tidak echo origin jahat, HSTS ada, burst kena 429, dan produksi menolak boot dengan CORS=*.
summary: Bukti: internal tanpa/salah token=401, benar=200. Preflight evil origin tidak di-echo, origin diizinkan di-echo. HSTS max-age=31536000 includeSubDomains preload, nosniff, DENY, referrer ada. Burst 130 request: 117x200 lalu 13x429 dengan Retry-After:17. NODE_ENV=production + CORS_ORIGINS=* gagal boot dengan pesan Insecure production configuration.

task: G4: production Docker images, .dockerignore, pre-deploy migrations, Render scaling
prompt: Siapkan deploy produksi: .dockerignore, migrasi sebagai preDeployCommand, >=2 replika, dan image yang benar-benar jalan.
summary: Dockerfile API ditulis ulang: builder frozen-lockfile + runner install prod-only (perbaiki prune yang gagal tanpa TTY), tsup bundle workspace jadi runner minimal. packages/db/migrate.mjs runner Node murni + tabel schema_migrations (idempoten). render.yaml: numInstances 2, preDeployCommand, pool/rate-limit env, header web lengkap. Tambah docker-compose.yml + script db:up/db:migrate/db:seed/docker:build.

task: G4: verify production images and pre-deploy migration end to end
prompt: Buktikan ketiga image build dan berjalan: ledger-api di Postgres, reporting-api menarik data dari ledger, web menyajikan header keamanan, dan migrasi jalan di dalam image.
summary: docker compose up -d db; migrate (1 applied) + seed (8 akun/5 entri). Tiga image build sukses. Container ledger-api: /health repository=postgres, 12 akun, internal 401, HSTS ada. preDeployCommand 'pnpm --filter @ledgerlab/db migrate:sql' di dalam image: idempoten (skip 0000). reporting-api container: dashboard balanced=true dari ledger container. web nginx: HSTS + nosniff + DENY + Permissions-Policy.

task: Audit ledger correctness changes for real defects
prompt: Audit reporting asOf, createJournalEntry/voidJournalEntry, both adapters, dan security.ts untuk hole: bypass, race, off-by-one, ketidakkonsistenan adapter.
summary: Agent menemukan 9 defect. Yang valid: (1) HIGH closed-period bisa dilewati dengan tanggal tidak nyata 2026-06-31; (2) adapter tidak menegakkan akun nonaktif sehingga seed bisa post ke akun mati; (3) void tidak dicek periode tertutup; (4) urutan tie date beda antar adapter; (5) token whitespace lolos; (6) reporting-api tak memvalidasi token saat produksi; (7) rate limit bisa di-bypass via XFF kiri; (8) RATE_LIMIT_MAX non-integer off-by-one; (9) seed idempotency terbatas 200 baris.

task: Fix adapter parity + date validation + rate-limit hardening from audit
prompt: Perbaiki defect temuan audit: validasi tanggal kalender nyata, void diblokir di periode tertutup, adapter menolak akun nonaktif, urutan tie date konsisten, token whitespace ditolak, reporting-api memvalidasi token, rate limit pakai hop terpercaya, dan seed idempoten lintas halaman.
summary: isoDateSchema + isIsoDate di domain (tolak 2026-06-31), dipakai di entry/route/report. LedgerService memvalidasi CLOSED_THROUGH dan memblokir void di periode tertutup. Kedua adapter menolak akun nonaktif. Memory sort pakai createdAt tiebreaker. assertProductionConfig trim token; rateLimitFromEnv butuh integer. clientKey pakai cf-connecting-ip lalu hop XFF terkanan. seed-cli paginasi semua halaman. Tes baru: tanggal mustahil 400, void periode tertutup 400, contract akun nonaktif (memory+postgres), XFF spoof tidak bypass, cf-connecting-ip, token whitespace.

task: G9: restore drill and infrastructure plan
prompt: Lakukan restore drill Postgres nyata lalu isi docs/INFRASTRUCTURE-PLAN.md lengkap dengan topologi, RPO/RTO, kapasitas, biaya, ADR.
summary: Restore drill: pg_dump 301ms, drop/recreate, pg_restore 694ms, baris identik (14 akun/6 entri/12 baris), SUM(amount_minor)=0. Dokumen diisi: topologi mermaid, RPO<=5min/RTO<=30min, biaya 1x/3x/10x = 35/90/320 USD, 4 ADR, tabel kontrol keamanan dengan path bukti. Tidak ada TODO tersisa.

task: G10 + submission: next-phase plan, sub-agents docs, submission writeup
prompt: Isi docs/NEXT-PHASE-PLAN.md (outcome, RICE, milestone, kapasitas, risiko, metrik, deferral, ADR), dokumentasikan sub-agent, dan tulis docs/SUBMISSION.md.
summary: NEXT-PHASE-PLAN: 4 outcome terukur, RICE, 3 milestone dengan exit criteria mundur dari bank go-live, 2 hire berikutnya, 5 risiko, metrik dengan sumber, 4 deferral, 2 ADR. SUBAGENTS.md: checklist + tabel pemakaian + defect yang ditangkap agent. SUBMISSION.md: perubahan per goal, output challenge suite, bukti keamanan, restore drill, status jujur bahwa deploy live belum dijalankan (butuh akun).
